newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-Seven Network to show South Africa tests live.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-Seven Network to show South Africa tests live.

text.p: Limited coverage of Australia's three-test series against South Africa will be shown live on free-to-air television, pay-television operator Foxtel said on Thursday.
Foxtel, which holds the broadcast rights to the series in South Africa, said in a statement it had reached an agreement with the Seven Network.
Seven's live coverage will begin at the start of the second session of play on each day of the five-day tests. Foxtel will cover all three sessions live each day.
